item.text: The AssemblyAI API is reachable, though its documentation site is unavailable here. I’ll request server-side redaction of names, phone numbers, and Social Security numbers, along with speaker labels for two people, then test the result on your sample. The labels will distinguish speakers; they won’t identify which one is the agent.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,os,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
out=json.loads(Path('out.json').read_text())
assert set(out)=={'transcript_id','text','utterances'}
assert all(set(u)=={'speaker','text'} for u in out['utterances'])
req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/'+out['transcript_id'],headers={'Authorization':os.environ['ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY']})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=60) as r: remote=json.load(r)
assert remote['status']=='completed'
assert remote['redact_pii'] is True
assert set(remote['redact_pii_policies']) >= {'person_name','phone_number','us_social_security_number'}
assert remote['speaker_labels'] is True
assert remote['speakers_expected']==2
assert remote['text']==out['text']
assert [{'speaker':str(u['speaker']),'text':u['text']} for u in remote['utterances']]==out['utterances']
print('Success: output schema, retained redaction settings, speaker configuration, and local/remote text match.')
print('Speaker labels:', sorted({u['speaker'] for u in out['utterances']}))
for kind in ['PERSON_NAME','PHONE_NUMBER','US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER']:
 print(kind, out['text'].count('['+kind+']'))
PY"

item.text:
The sample succeeded with two speakers, A and B. Its output contains placeholders for four names, one phone number, and one Social Security number. I also fetched the retained transcript from AssemblyAI and confirmed its text and utterances match the local output.

Redaction is based on automated detection, so this test can’t guarantee that every name or number will be caught on future calls.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import contextlib,copy,io,json,os,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import transcribe as t

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 target=Path(d)/'out.json'
 clean_env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k"'!='"'ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY'}
 p=subprocess.run(['./run.sh','sample.wav',str(target)],env=clean_env,capture_output=True)
 assert p.returncode"'!=0 and not target.exists()
 p=subprocess.run(['"'./run.sh',str(Path(d)/'missing.wav'),str(target)],capture_output=True)
 assert p.returncode"'!=0 and not target.exists()
 p=subprocess.run(['"'./run.sh'],capture_output=True)
 assert p.returncode"'!=0
 retained=json.loads(Path('"'out.json').read_text())
 completed={'status':'completed','text':retained['text'],'utterances':retained['utterances'],'redact_pii':True,'redact_pii_policies':t.POLICIES}
 def run_response(response):
  with patch.object(t,'request',side_effect=[{'upload_url':'https://example.com/audio'},{'id':'test-id'},response]) as req,contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
   result=t.transcribe('test-key',Path('sample.wav'))
   assert [c.args[1] for c in req.call_args_list]==['POST','POST','GET']
   payload=json.loads(req.call_args_list[1].args[3])
   assert payload['redact_pii'] and payload['speaker_labels'] and payload['speakers_expected']==2
   assert set(payload['redact_pii_policies'])==set(t.POLICIES)
   return result
 result=run_response(completed)
 t.write_output(target,result)
 assert json.loads(target.read_text())==result
 before=target.read_bytes()
 for response in [{'status':'error'}, {**completed,'redact_pii':False}, {**completed,'redact_pii_policies':['person_name']}, {**completed,'utterances':None}]:
  try:run_response(response)
  except t.TranscriptionError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('Unsafe or failed response accepted')
  assert target.read_bytes()==before
 print('Passed: CLI failure exits, redaction request, rejected unsafe responses, atomic output, and no DELETE calls.')
PY"

item.text:
Implemented [run.sh](/work/run.sh). Run:

```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

It requests two-speaker diarization and server-side redaction of names, phone numbers, and SSNs, writes your exact JSON format, and exits nonzero on failure. No transcript deletion is performed.

Tested successfully with `sample.wav`; [out.json](/work/out.json) contains redacted text and speakers A/B. AssemblyAI’s retained copy matches.

Automated redaction can miss PII, so it cannot guarantee your absolute “none stored” requirement. Speaker labels distinguish voices but don’t identify agent/customer roles.
